craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at willed-measure — tenderness (vatsa) inside rigor. Called-bound: narrowing-gained-called triple; will-measured close. Rejected: (a) bound→limited → killed: bandha load term. Read aloud: AC-tion-MIND NARR-owed, GAINED … BLESS-ed BHAI-ra-va IS-mea-SURED.

lines: Action-mind narrowed, gained — then called bound soul;
thus by will, blessed Bhairava is measured.
l4.sanskrit_cite: karmabuddhyakṣatāṃ prāptā tadāsau paśur ucyate | itīcchayā sa bhagavān bhairavaḥ parimīyate

reads_against.argmap: When is the bound soul called? → Limited obtained called bound; willed measured Bhairava.
